messages:
nina_sales: Thread to track Northstar Financial POC asks. They want BYO-HSM + attested hardware, support for key-splitting/threshold signing, and a monthly KEK rotation. Also requested a DR drill schedule and pricing model variance (per-hsm-op vs fixed premium).

omar_se: A couple clarifying Qs: do they need in-band HSM calls for every sign/decrypt, or are they ok with Redwood doing periodic wrapping and caching to reduce HSM ops?

northstar_ciso: For sensitive flows we require HSM-backed ops for every KEK unwrap in prod. Pilot can use cached wrapping for 24h. Also: need PKCS#11 and KMIP adapters supported, and signed attestation documents from the HSM vendor.

jules_sec: Security checklist: require HSM attestation chain, FIPS 140-2 Level 3 or 140-3 equivalent, signed firmware manifest, and support for split keys (we'll need proof of threshold implementation). Pen test window: 21 days external.

frank_ops: Ops notes: supporting per-op HSM will add steady CPU/network overhead and increase p99 by ~70-150ms depending on region. For monthly KEK rotation we can do zero-downtime rewrap if customer agrees to staged dual-KEK acceptance for 48h. We'll need to test with a DR drill.

omar_se: Suggest architecture: Redwood holds only wrapped data keys; KEKs live on customer HSMs and we perform a per-request unwrap/rewrap. Use prefix-KV caching for ephemeral contexts to limit hits. For threshold signing, we'll coordinate multi-key invocation via customer's HSM cluster.

northstar_ciso: DR ask: we want an annual DR drill with Redwood where we simulate HSM outage and failover to secondary site without key material leakage. Can you commit to a test runbook?

jules_sec: We'll add a DR runbook item and require an audit trail entry for every DR operation. Also include a rollback window and signed attestations post-drill.

mia_fin: Pricing note: rough estimate: +20% reserved capacity premium for BYO-HSM + attestation and threshold orchestration, plus an ongoing per-hsm-op surcharge if they insist on per-request unwrapping (estimated $0.0005 per HSM op). One-time setup ~$30k for runbooks, attestation validation, and DR playbook.

presales_bot: Template: https://redwood.internal/sow/templates/threshold-byohsm-v1 0-point attestation checklist included.

frank_ops: Minimal onboarding payload we need from customer:
```
HSM_VENDOR=thales
HSM_API=pkcs11
HSM_ENDPOINT=tcp://hsm-ns1.northstar:5555
ALLOWED_IPS=[35.189.7.10]
ROTATION_WINDOW=monthly
DR_CONTACTS=[ops@northstar.com]
```

nina_sales: Action items: 1) Omar to draft technical SOW addendum with threshold and rotation language, 2) Jules to confirm security attestation checklist and pen test window, 3) Mia to produce a line-item estimate, 4) Frank to build DR runbook draft. Meeting to review tomorrow 9am PT.

omar_se: I'll post the SOW draft + sequence diagram here before 9am.

mia_fin: I'll attach a provisional quote (numbers only) by EOD today.

jules_sec: I'll confirm whether FIPS 140-3 equivalence is acceptable; will also list required artifact templates.

northstar_ciso: Thanks. We'll provide attestation certs and network allowlist by EOD. Also can you include a sample contract clause for "DR Key Custody Simulation"?

presales_bot: See sample clause at section 5.3 in template v1.

nina_sales: Great. If blockers pop up ping @nina_sales. :white_check_mark:
